definitions.explanation: Describes services, facilities, or enterprises that are operated by a government body (national, prefectural, or municipal), as opposed to private ownership.

examples.japanese: {公営|こうえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公営|こうえい}だ。
examples.english: This parking lot is publicly operated by the city.

examples.japanese: {公営|こうえい}⟦ギャンブル→ギャンブル：10811_gyanburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧や⟦{競輪|けいりん}→競輪：09247_keirin⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Public gambling includes horse racing and bicycle racing.

notes:
Describes services, facilities, or enterprises operated by a government body (national, prefectural, or municipal). Contrasts with {民営|みんえい} (privately operated) and {私営|しえい} (privately run).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公営|こうえい}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧: public housing
- {公営|こうえい}{企業|きぎょう}: public enterprise
- {公営|こうえい}⟦ギャンブル→ギャンブル：10811_gyanburu⟧: legalized public gambling
- {公営|こうえい}⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: public parking lot
- {公営|こうえい}⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧: publicly operated bus

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {民営|みんえい}: privately operated — the direct opposite; ⟦{民営化|みんえいか}→民営化：17587_mineika⟧ means privatization
- {国営|こくえい}: state-run — specifically operated by the national government
- {市営|しえい}: city-operated — specifically run by a city/municipal government
